answer: Two leasing companies changed their third-party buyout rules on February 1, 2026. Crescent Motor Credit has allowed third-party buyouts since that date. Apex Lease Co still allows them, but since that date it adds a $350 third-party buyout fee to the buyout amount.

facts.fact: Crescent Motor Credit (buyouts allowed since then)
Apex Lease Co (a $350 buyout fee since then)
